text: Best blind ever. Love the color, perfect look, good quality

product_metadata.title: Lewis Hyman 0240731 Radiance Sahara Woven Wood Bamboo Roll Up Window Blind, 30-Inch Wide by 72-Inch Long, Natural
features: Matchstick shades come standard with a matching 6 inch valance
Natural insulation properties effectively block and trap heat
Constructed of real bamboo and other environmentally friendly materials
Conforms with C.P.S.C. child safety guidelines
description: This exotic Sahara Natural Woven Wood Bamboo Shade will look great with a jute rug in any room. Feel like you are on a Tahitian island as the early morning sunlight glides across the room. Use under other window treatments for an added layer of texture. This bamboo shade softly filters light and rolls up for a rich look. It comes in various measurements that are sure to fit the size of your window.
